import h5py, numpy as np, collections, re, os, json
fn='finding.geo.q1.h5ad'
def decode_arr(a, n=None):
    if n is not None: a=a[:n]
    return [x.decode() if isinstance(x,bytes) else str(x) for x in a]
with h5py.File(fn,'r') as f:
    obs=decode_arr(f['obs/_index'][:])
    var=decode_arr(f['var/_index'][:])
    cats=decode_arr(f['var/gene_symbols/categories'][:])
    codes=f['var/gene_symbols/codes'][:]
    syms=[cats[c] if c>=0 else '' for c in codes]
    indptr=f['X/indptr'][:]
    data=f['X/data'][:]
    row_nnz=np.diff(indptr)
    row_sum=np.add.reduceat(data, indptr[:-1])
    print('shape', len(obs), len(var), 'nnz', len(data))
    print('obs first20')
    print('\\n'.join(obs[:20]))
    print('obs last20')
    print('\\n'.join(obs[-20:]))
    print('unique obs prefixes before _/- sample?', collections.Counter([re.split(r'[-_:.]',x)[0] for x in obs]).most_common(20))
    print('barcode lens', collections.Counter(map(len, obs)).most_common())
    print('suffixes', collections.Counter([x[-3:] for x in obs]).most_common(20))
    print('var first20')
    for a,b in list(zip(var,syms))[:20]: print(a,b)
    print('var last20')
    for a,b in list(zip(var,syms))[-20:]: print(a,b)
    print('ensembl prefix counts', collections.Counter([v[:4] for v in var]).most_common(20))
    print('row sum min/quant/max', row_sum.min(), np.quantile(row_sum,[0,.01,.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,.99]), row_sum.max())
    print('row nnz min/quant/max', row_nnz.min(), np.quantile(row_nnz,[0,.01,.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,.99]), row_nnz.max())
    print('total counts', int(row_sum.sum()))
    print('top genes by counts')
    col_sum=np.zeros(len(var), dtype=np.int64)
    indices=f['X/indices'][:]
    np.add.at(col_sum, indices, data)
    for i in np.argsort(col_sum)[-30:][::-1]: print(i, var[i], syms[i], int(col_sum[i]))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import h5py, numpy as np
with h5py.File('finding.geo.q1.h5ad','r') as lf, h5py.File('GSM3578982_raw_gene_bc_matrices_h5.h5','r') as rf:
    local_obs=np.array([x.decode() for x in lf['obs/_index'][:]])
    local_var=np.array([x.decode() for x in lf['var/_index'][:]])
    rg=rf['output_genome2']
    raw_barcodes=np.array([x.decode() for x in rg['barcodes'][:]])
    raw_genes=np.array([x.decode() for x in rg['genes'][:]])
    raw_gene_names=np.array([x.decode() for x in rg['gene_names'][:]])
    indptr=rg['indptr'][:]; data=rg['data'][:]
    sums=np.add.reduceat(data, indptr[:-1])
    # for empty columns where indptr equal maybe reduceat fails? check values for indptr diff zero; reduceat at same positions? compute robust loop via bincount using repeated? use diff data sums by cumsum
    cs=np.concatenate([[0],np.cumsum(data,dtype=np.int64)])
    sums=cs[indptr[1:]]-cs[indptr[:-1]]
    local_set=set(local_obs)
    for op,mask in [('>200',sums>200),('>250',sums>250),('>273',sums>273),('>=274',sums>=274),('>300',sums>300),('>500',sums>500)]:
        arr=raw_barcodes[mask]
        print(op, len(arr), 'equals local', np.array_equal(arr, local_obs), 'intersect', len(set(arr)&local_set))
    print('local equals >=274?', np.array_equal(raw_barcodes[sums>=274],local_obs))
    print('local min raw sum', sums[np.searchsorted(raw_barcodes, local_obs)].min(), 'max nonlocal', max(sums[~np.isin(raw_barcodes,local_obs)]))
    missing=[(g,n) for g,n in zip(raw_genes,raw_gene_names) if g not in set(local_var)]
    extra=[g for g in local_var if g not in set(raw_genes)]
    print('missing raw genes in local', len(missing), missing[:20])
    print('extra local genes', len(extra), extra[:20])
PY"

import h5py, numpy as np
with h5py.File('finding.geo.q1.h5ad','r') as lf, h5py.File('GSM3578982_raw_gene_bc_matrices_h5.h5','r') as rf:
    local_obs=lf['obs/_index'][:]
    local_var=lf['var/_index'][:]
    rg=rf['output_genome2']
    raw_barcodes=rg['barcodes'][:]
    raw_genes=rg['genes'][:]
    raw_names=rg['gene_names'][:]
    indptr=rg['indptr'][:]; data=rg['data'][:]
    cs=np.concatenate(([0], np.cumsum(data, dtype=np.int64)))
    sums=cs[indptr[1:]]-cs[indptr[:-1]]
    for threshold in [200,250,273,274,300,500,1000]:
        arr=raw_barcodes[sums>=threshold]
        print('>=',threshold,'n',len(arr),'equals',np.array_equal(arr, local_obs))
    # since raw barcodes sorted, local sorted, find positions via searchsorted
    pos=np.searchsorted(raw_barcodes, local_obs)
    print('all local barcodes in raw', bool(np.all(raw_barcodes[pos]==local_obs)))
    print('local raw sum min max', int(sums[pos].min()), int(sums[pos].max()))
    mask=np.ones(len(raw_barcodes), dtype=bool); mask[pos]=False
    print('nonlocal raw sum max', int(sums[mask].max()))
    raw_gene_set=set(raw_genes.tolist()); local_gene_set=set(local_var.tolist())
    miss=[(g.decode(),n.decode()) for g,n in zip(raw_genes,raw_names) if g not in local_gene_set]
    print('raw genes',len(raw_genes),'local genes',len(local_var),'missing in local',miss[:10])
PY"
